provenance_note: All 2589 checks are recomputed by the reference; corrections and specification changes are recorded in the reference file.
reference: Independent python reference written by a second agent from a method specification and the case files only, without access to the page code: scipy PCHIP checked against the specified end rule, Colebrook solved for 1/sqrt(f) to machine precision, the specified 600/800-cell root scan refined by Brent's method, affinity and fan laws, efficiency, power and NPSH. Every case input, including the seeded random draws, is stored in benchmarks/operatingpoint.reference.json.
reference_citations: C.F. Colebrook, Turbulent flow in pipes, with particular reference to the transition region between the smooth and rough pipe laws, J. Inst. Civ. Eng. 11 (1939) 133–156.
Hydraulic Institute pump affinity-law and operating-point conventions; AMCA fan/system-curve and fan-law conventions are the engineering basis used by the tool.

tolerance.en: Pass if |page - reference| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |reference|); flow abs 2e-10 m3/s (twice the page's root bracket), case-level overrides where an output moves more than that within the bracket (micro-flow and Re 2300 cases), one grid step for the estimated stable-flow limit; strings, statuses and warning lists exact.
tolerance.uk: Перевірку пройдено, якщо |сторінка - еталон| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |еталон|); для витрати abs 2e-10 m3/s (подвоєний інтервал локалізації кореня на сторінці), перевизначення на рівні випадку там, де вихідне значення в межах цього інтервалу змінюється більше (випадки мікровитрати та Re 2300), один крок сітки для оціненої межі стабільної витрати; рядки, статуси й списки попереджень — точно.
tolerance.de: Bestanden, wenn |Seite - Referenz| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |Referenz|); Volumenstrom abs 2e-10 m3/s (das Doppelte des Nullstellen-Einschlussintervalls der Seite), fallbezogene Überschreibungen, wo sich ein Ausgabewert innerhalb des Intervalls stärker als dies ändert (Fälle mit Kleinstvolumenstrom und Re 2300), ein Rasterschritt für die geschätzte Grenze des stabilen Volumenstroms; Zeichenketten, Status und Warnungslisten exakt.
tolerance.nl: Geslaagd als |pagina - referentie| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |referentie|); debiet abs 2e-10 m3/s (tweemaal het insluitingsinterval van de wortel op de pagina), overschrijvingen per geval waar een uitvoer binnen het interval meer dan dat verschuift (gevallen met microdebiet en Re 2300), één rasterstap voor de geschatte grens van het stabiele debiet; strings, statussen en waarschuwingslijsten exact.
tolerance.fr: Réussi si |page - référence| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |référence|) ; débit abs 2e-10 m3/s (deux fois l'intervalle d'encadrement de la racine de la page), dérogations au niveau du cas lorsqu'une sortie varie davantage dans l'intervalle (cas de micro-débit et Re 2300), un pas de grille pour la limite de débit stable estimée ; chaînes, statuts et listes d'avertissements exacts.
tolerance.es: Pasa si |página - referencia| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |referencia|); caudal abs 2e-10 m3/s (el doble del intervalo de acotación de la raíz de la página), excepciones por caso donde una salida varía más que eso dentro del intervalo (casos de microcaudal y Re 2300), un paso de malla para el límite de caudal estable estimado; cadenas, estados y listas de advertencias exactos.
tolerance.pl: Zaliczone, jeśli |strona - wzorzec| <= max(abs, 1e-6 x |wzorzec|); przepływ abs 2e-10 m3/s (dwukrotność przedziału lokalizacji pierwiastka na stronie), nadpisania na poziomie przypadku tam, gdzie wynik zmienia się w tym przedziale bardziej (przypadki mikroprzepływu i Re 2300), jeden krok siatki dla szacowanej granicy przepływu stabilnego; łańcuchy, statusy i listy ostrzeżeń dokładnie.

H.why: inherits Q accuracy through a smooth curve

dp.why: inherits Q accuracy; |G|<1e-8 Pa page residual

P_hyd.why: rho g Q H, product of 1e-6-accurate terms

NPSHa.why: closed form at Q*; abs floor 1 micrometre

f_darcy.why: Colebrook exact vs fixed point differ <1e-14 (A5); Re carries Q accuracy

Q_stable_min.why: supplied value x r x N, or the exact PCHIP peak (a data point) x r x N (method.md 4.5, A13): pure arithmetic, no grid override any more

notices.why: ungraded since 2026-10-15 (method.md 7); kept here for reference only

permalink_clamped.why: compare field, given and used of each entry, order-insensitive; label is not specified by method.md

state.why: used values of the given state keys after the range limits of method.md 2.1

roots.why: same as Q, element-wise, same count

parsed_points.why: pure unit conversions; null must match null

control_target_Q.why: typed/3600 exact, or 0.8*Q* which inherits Q accuracy

control_setting.why: 60/65 bisection steps resolve far below 1e-6 %; root noise 1e-10 m3/s maps to <1e-6 %

verdict.why: fixed strings joined by one space

process: Phase 1: a driver agent wrote the stored case inputs, the method specification and the page driver, and wrote no expected values. Phase 2: a second agent wrote the reference from the case inputs and the specification only, without access to the page code. Phase 3: the page outputs were graded against the reference with the reference tolerances unchanged; disputed points were adjudicated against the specification and every correction is recorded in the reference file.

reference_corrections.change: Following cases.json spec_changes, the graded keys are now status, reason and warnings. The point-value keys and verdict, which had been not_derivable, were dropped. Added reason = 'noroot' (method.md 3.8: demo curve, no root found). status and warnings are unchanged.
No value changed. The new method.md section 6/7 rule (control_setting null when no control case exists) is what expected.json already gave. The rationale in the notes now cites the rule.

Tolerance: the Q_stable_min override of one 801-grid step was removed. The stable-flow estimate is now the exact PCHIP peak (method.md 4.5, A13), graded at rel 1e-9 like a supplied value. The per-value entries below list every expected value that changed in revision 2026-10-15.

Revision 2026-10-16. Friction transition: the cubic is built independently as a Hermite cubic from its four end conditions and agrees with eq. D.4 to 8e-15; value and slope are continuous at Re 2000 and 4000. Pump root choice: highest-flow stable root, with root_stable and no_stable_root as new outputs. PR04's alternate_expected block and its jump tolerance overrides are gone. PR03 and TR3000 get an h_discharge_pipe override of about 1.9e-9 m from the page's 1e-10 m3/s root bracket. Per-value entries dated 2026-10-16 follow.

Follow-up to the clarified spec. CE07 is now graded on status, reason and warnings: the not_derivable point values were dropped and reason 'curveNoIntersect' was added. The value was already computed; status and warnings are unchanged. FX7A-FX7D: notices is no longer expected (ungraded). Section 6 now has one existence rule; the code applies it alone. No control value changed: PC05/FX8A targets exceed Q* + tol, and FX8B (67.1 m3/h) lies below Q*. Concern notes were corrected: FX1A Q* is 0.856 L/s = 3.08 m3/h. The FX8B concern about two rules is withdrawn.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A1 root selection with several intersections
reference_decisions.decision: Pump: a root is stable when F = H_pump - H_sys changes from + to - across it (an exact-zero sample root when F > 0 before and F < 0 after). The operating point is the highest-flow stable root; if none is stable, the lowest root, with the 'No stable intersection' message. Fan: highest-flow stable root, else the highest root. Brackets come from the method grid (600/800 cells); each is refined by Brent.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 3.8, 4.5, A1. This is the physical stability criterion for a quasi-steady machine on a resistance system (dH_pump/dQ < dH_sys/dQ).

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A2 friction in the transition band 2000 < Re < 4000
reference_decisions.decision: 64/Re up to Re 2000; Colebrook-White from Re 4000; in between, the cubic in R = Re/2000 with f(2000) = 0.032, df/dRe(2000) = -64/2000^2, f(4000) = f_CW(4000) and df/dRe(4000) = df_CW/dRe(4000). It is built independently as a Hermite cubic, with df_CW/dRe obtained by implicit differentiation of Colebrook-White (checked against finite differences to 7e-9). It agrees with method.md's eq. D.4 to 8e-15 for eps_r 0 to 0.05. The value jump at both ends is below 2e-12 for a 1e-7 step in Re, and the slopes match.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 3.4 (EPANET 2 Dunlop interpolation with Colebrook-White end values).
reference_decisions.concern: The cubic is a smooth bridge, not a measured law. Transitional pipe flow is intermittent. At PR03 (Re 3156, eps_r 4.5e-4) the cubic gives f = 0.0347, against 0.0433 for Colebrook-White and 0.0203 for 64/Re, a band of -41 % to +25 % around the chosen value. Only the micro-flow cases (PR02-PR04, TR2000-TR4000, FX6B) operate in the band. The former Re 2300 jump artefact (PR04) is gone.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A3 root exactly at a grid sample
reference_decisions.decision: Pump: an exact zero at a sample counts only for Q > 0 (revision 2026-10-15); CE07 and FX6A have no operating point. Fan: an exact zero is not counted; no fan case hits one.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 3.8 and A3; physically a zero-flow 'intersection' is dead-heading, not an operating point.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A4 page root accuracy is absolute
reference_decisions.decision: Reference roots to machine precision; Q tolerance rel 1e-6 with abs floor 2e-10 m3/s; for every numeric output the script evaluates the change over +-1e-10 m3/s and widens the tolerance per case where that change exceeds the global tolerance.
reference_decisions.why: Tolerance must cover the page's documented stopping rule, not more.

reference_decisions.decision: Exact root of Colebrook-White (Brent on y = 1/sqrt f, Newton polish).
reference_decisions.why: Fixed point converges to the same root to < 1e-14 relative.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A6 demo pump head clipped at 0
reference_decisions.decision: H = r^2 max(0, h0 - a q_b^2) as specified.
reference_decisions.why: A pump cannot deliver negative head in this quasi-steady model; the clip is the documented curve.

reference_decisions.decision: Per column over the kept rows: if any finite eta > 1.5, every finite eta is divided by 100 (FX2A, PI10, FX2C); a column whose largest value is exactly 1.5 is read as fractions (FX2B). Clamp to [0.01, 1] (pump) or [0.02, 1] (fan) at use.
reference_decisions.why: A unit is a column property (method.md 5 step 8, revision 2026-10-15).

reference_decisions.decision: H[m] = p[kPa]*1000/(rho_w(T_import) g) with T from the state applied before the import.
reference_decisions.why: Documented; physically the conversion should use the test-fluid density.

reference_decisions.decision: Pump: P_curve scaled by r^3 N_p only; fan: by r^3 N_f rho/rho_ref.
reference_decisions.why: Documented.
reference_decisions.concern: Pump shaft power is proportional to fluid density; an imported cold-water power curve used at 80-95 C overstates power by up to 4 %.

reference_decisions.decision: Normalised cell matches when equal to or starting with an alias; first matching column per key; header if any cell matches any alias.
reference_decisions.why: Documented.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A11 range limits of loaded states
reference_decisions.decision: Slider/select fields are limited to their UI range (pumps/fans rounded with JavaScript Math.round first; non-finite or non-numeric -> default); p1, p2, z1 and the fixed constants are used as given. Machine limits and control-set values (e.g. VFD speed down to 20 %) are not limited. Clamped earlier cases: PI10, CE04, CE05, CE06 (z2), CE13 (z2 33 -> 32), FD10 (damper).
reference_decisions.why: method.md 2.1.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: A12 pump reason for imported curves
reference_decisions.decision: Without extrapolation and no root: repeat the scan with chord extrapolation on the extrapolated interval of 3.8; a root there -> curveRange, otherwise curveNoIntersect. With extrapolation and no root -> curveNoIntersect. Demo -> noroot.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 3.8 and A12.

reference_decisions.decision: Exact maximum of the PCHIP interpolant on [q_first, q_last]: nodes at their data values plus interior critical points of each cubic farther than 1e-9 in t from a node; the lowest flow wins among equal maxima; a two-point curve uses the higher end point. Graded at rel 1e-9 (no grid override).
reference_decisions.why: method.md 4.5; physically the peak of the pressure curve. PCHIP is monotone per interval, so the peak is a data point in every case here.

reference_decisions.decision: Grid bracketing (to reproduce detectability) + Brent refinement.
reference_decisions.why: Same mathematical root; Brent reaches machine precision.

reference_decisions.decision: Non-finite or <= 0 -> 0.8 Q*; any other target is kept. One existence rule: a case exists iff Q(lo) - tol <= target <= Q* + tol (tol 1e-9 pump, 1e-8 fan); 1.0005 Q* only selects the message. Without a case, control_setting is null and the state is unchanged (PC05, FX8A). With a case the setting is solved by Brent on Q(s) = target. 'immediate' Apply uses the same target, so FX8C/FX8D equal PC01/FC02.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 6 and A15.

reference_decisions.decision: Root choice (A1) and friction transition (A2) follow revision 2026-10-16. The former concerns are closed: the lowest-root rule and the Re 2300 jump.
reference_decisions.why: method.md A16.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: X7 outputs notices, permalink_clamped and state
reference_decisions.decision: permalink_clamped = [{field, given, used}] in the field order of method.md 3.1/4.1, without 'label' (ungraded text key); graded order-insensitively. notices is ungraded (method.md 7) and no longer expected. state = the given state keys with their used values.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 2.1 and 7 define the content but not the labels or the number format.

reference_decisions.decision: The preset button resets the pump state to the 3.1 defaults, then applies its values (High static head: z2 23, speed 70); range notices of the loaded state are still computed from the input state.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 2 and 3.10.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: X1 'linear continuation of the first/last segment' when extrapolating
reference_decisions.decision: Chord (secant) line through the two end points of the segment.
reference_decisions.why: Consistent with method.md 3.8, whose Q_zero uses the last-segment chord slope (h_{n-1} - h_{n-2})/(q_{n-1} - q_{n-2}). The tangent alternative is reported in the notes of each extrapolated case.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: X2 Q_raw,max in the extrapolated pump search range
reference_decisions.decision: Q_raw,max = q_last r N_p (scaled), like dq and dh.
reference_decisions.why: Q_zero mixes Q_raw,max with scaled dq, dh; only the scaled reading is dimensionally consistent.

reference_decisions.ambiguity: X3 curve domain end points under float round-off
reference_decisions.decision: q_b within 1e-12 of the span outside [q_first, q_last] is treated as inside.
reference_decisions.why: Q_max/(r N) may round just past q_last; the end point is mathematically in range.

reference_decisions.decision: Stable when G changes sign from + to - across the bracket (dG/dQ < 0).
reference_decisions.why: Equivalent to the page's finite difference for any transversal root; exact sign.

reference_decisions.decision: Each bound is tested if supplied; a region is supplied if either bound is.
reference_decisions.why: No case has a single bound; recorded for completeness.

reference_decisions.decision: With absolute mode, a negative margin raises both 'NPSH margin is negative' and 'Specified NPSH margin requirement is not met.' in the verdict.
reference_decisions.why: method.md 3.9 lists them as independent checks.
